unsaved-changes-confirmation: Message shown when the user attempts to leave a page with unsaved changes.
back-to-round: Label for navigate back to the round page button
montage-round-check-source: Button in the new-round form that checks the import source (category, file list URL or file list) on Wikimedia Commons before the round is saved.
montage-round-check-running: Button label shown while the import source is being checked.
montage-round-check-required: Help text under the check button; also shown when Save is pressed before a check.
montage-round-check-summary:
Summary of the check of a CSV, Google Sheet, gist or file list. Parameters:
* {0} - rows in the source
* {1} - files that will be imported
montage-round-check-blocking: Error shown when the import check found rows that block the import.
montage-round-check-no-issues: Shown when every row of the import source was found on Commons.
montage-round-check-truncated:
Shown above a shortened list of rows with issues. Parameters:
* {0} - rows shown
* {1} - rows with issues in total
montage-round-check-download: Link to download the files that can be imported, as a CSV file with the columns filename and file_id. Shown when the check found no blocking problems.
montage-round-check-download-partial: Link shown instead of {{msg-wm|Montage-montage-round-check-download}} when the check blocks the import: the CSV file holds only the rows without problems (all files of a same-name group are left out). The instructions follow in {{msg-wm|Montage-montage-round-check-download-partial-help}}.
montage-round-check-expired: Shown when a round is saved with a check older than 1 hour (files change on Commons) or otherwise no longer valid.
montage-round-check-ignored-columns:
Shown after a CSV check: the CSV columns Montage does not use (only filename and file_id are used). Parameters:
* {0} - comma-separated column names, as written in the CSV
montage-round-check-col-row: Column header in the import check table: row number in the source (spreadsheet row or line).
montage-round-check-col-name: Column header: the file name as written in the source.
montage-round-check-col-file-id: Column header: the file_id as written in the source.
montage-round-check-col-commons-name: Column header: the current name of the file on Wikimedia Commons.
montage-round-check-col-status: Column header: the result of the check for this row.
montage-round-check-col-reason: Column header: an explanation of the status (in English).
montage-round-check-status-ok: Import check status: the file was found on Commons.
montage-round-check-status-renamed: Import check status: the file was found by its file ID under another name; it is imported under its current name.
montage-round-check-status-duplicate: Import check status: the same Commons file appears in an earlier row; it is imported once.
montage-round-check-status-unknown-name: Import check status: no file with this name exists on Commons; the row is left out.
montage-round-check-status-unknown-file-: Import check status: no file with this file ID exists on Commons; this blocks the import.
montage-round-check-status-malformed-fil: Import check status: the file ID is not a plain whole number (for example 1.49673E+08); this blocks the import.
montage-round-check-status-page-id: Import check status: a number in the list is the page ID of a file page on Commons (shown under Page information), not the file ID Montage needs; this blocks the import.
montage-round-check-status-revision-id: Import check status: a number in the list is a revision ID (one edit of a file page on Commons), not the file ID Montage needs; this blocks the import.
montage-round-check-status-ambiguous-id: Import check status: a number in the list is the file ID of one file but also the page ID or a revision ID of another file page, so it is unclear which file is meant; this blocks the import.
montage-round-check-status-same-name: Import check status: a different file in the same import (not a file already in Montage) has a name that the database treats as the same (for example differing only in case, accents or е/ё).
montage-round-check-same-name-title: Heading above groups of file names that Montage cannot tell apart (they differ only in case, accents or similar letters; Montage's database compares names that way).
montage-round-check-same-name-list: Advice for same-name groups in a CSV or file list (they block the import). "е and ё" is an example of two letters that are compared as the same; keep it or use a similar pair from your language.
montage-round-check-same-name-category: Explanation for same-name groups in a category import (they do not block it). "е and ё" is an example; keep it or use a similar pair from your language.
montage-round-import-warning: Title of the dialog shown after a round was saved with its files, when some rows were left out or changed, or files were disqualified.
montage-round-check-nothing-to-import: Shown when the import check found no file that can be imported; the round cannot be saved (hatnote/montage#447).
montage-round-check-failed-short: Shown when checking the import source failed; the reason from the server (in English) is shown below it.
montage-round-check-count:
One line of the import check counts. Parameters:
* {0} - a status label (e.g. "Not on Commons")
* {1} - the number of rows with that status
montage-round-check-row-ref:
Shown after a file name in a list of files whose names the database treats as the same; kept on one line. Parameters:
* {0} - the file's row number in the source
montage-round-check-and: Read by screen readers between two file names shown side by side (the visible separator is an arrow).
montage-round-check-summary-category:
Summary of the check of a category. Parameters:
* {0} - files in the category
* {1} - files that will be imported
montage-round-check-issues-label: Accessible name and caption of the table of rows with issues in the import check.
montage-round-check-blocks: Added after the status of a row that blocks the import, so this is not shown by colour only.
montage-round-check-download-issues: Link to download every row of the import check that is not OK, as a CSV file.
montage-round-check-cleared: Read by screen readers when the import source is edited after a check, which clears the check result.
montage-round-category-pick: Shown under the category field when text was typed but no category was picked from the list.
montage-round-saving-with-files: Label of the save button while a first round is saved together with its files.
montage-round-added-with-files:
Message after a first round was saved with its files. Parameters:
* {0} - the number of files added to the round
montage-round-save-blocked-recheck: Shown when saving a round was refused because the checked source blocks the import. The server details (in English) follow.
montage-round-reload-page: Shown when a page loaded before an update sends an import the new version refuses.
montage-round-not-saved: Shown next to the save button when saving a first round failed on the server. The server details (in English) follow.
montage-round-save-unknown: Shown when no answer came back while saving a first round (network or timeout).
montage-btn-ok: Label of a button that closes a message dialog.
montage-round-check-download-partial-hel: Instructions shown after the link {{msg-wm|Montage-montage-round-check-download-partial}}. "File List" is the source option {{msg-wm|Montage-montage-round-source-filelist}} and should match its translation.
montage-round-check-warnings-only: Shown after a check that found problems that do not block the import (for example files not on Commons, listed twice, or renamed).
montage-round-save-hint-unchecked: Shown next to the disabled Save button of a first round before the source has been checked.
montage-round-save-hint-blocked: Shown next to the disabled Save button when the check found rows that block the import. The check result is shown higher up in the form.
montage-round-save-hint-empty: Shown next to the disabled Save button when the check found no file that can be imported.
montage-round-check-reason-renamed:
Details of a checked row whose file was renamed on Commons. Parameters:
* {0} - the name as written in the source
* {1} - the current name on Commons
montage-round-check-reason-duplicate:
Details of a checked row that lists a file already listed in an earlier row. Parameters:
* {0} - the row number of the first listing
montage-round-check-reason-unknown-name:
Details of a checked row whose file name does not exist on Commons. Parameters:
* {0} - the file name
montage-round-check-reason-unknown-file-:
Details of a checked row whose file ID (the number Commons gives each file) does not exist. Parameters:
* {0} - the number
montage-round-check-reason-malformed-fil:
Details of a checked row whose file ID column holds something that is not a whole number (for example 1.49673E+08 from a spreadsheet). Parameters:
* {0} - the cell as written
montage-round-check-reason-page-id:
Details of a checked row that holds the page ID of a file page (shown under Page information on Commons) instead of a file ID. "File:" is the Commons namespace prefix. Parameters:
* {0} - the number
* {1} - the file name
montage-round-check-reason-revision-id:
Details of a checked row that holds a revision ID (the number of one edit of a page) instead of a file ID. "File:" is the Commons namespace prefix. Parameters:
* {0} - the number
* {1} - the file name
montage-round-check-reason-ambiguous-id:
Details of a checked row whose number is the file ID of one file and the page or revision ID of another. Parameters:
* {0} - the number
* {1} - the file with that file ID
* {2} - the other file
montage-round-check-reason-same-name:
Details of a checked row whose file name Montage cannot tell apart from another file's name in the same import (differs only in case, accents or similar letters). Parameters:
* {0} - the other file name(s), each followed by its row reference ({{msg-wm|Montage-montage-round-check-row-ref}}), separated by commas
montage-round-check-reason-same-name-cat:
Details of a file left out of a category import because Montage cannot tell its name apart from another file's name. Parameters:
* {0} - the file that is imported
montage-round-check-error-csv-unreadable: Error when checking a source: the linked file is not valid CSV.
montage-round-check-error-too-many-rows:
Error when checking a source that is too long. Parameters:
* {0} - number of rows
* {1} - the maximum
montage-round-check-error-no-file-names: Error when checking an empty File List.
montage-round-check-error-sheet-link-inv: Error when a Google Sheets link cannot be understood.
montage-round-check-error-https-only:
Error when the source link does not start with https://. Parameters:
* {0} - the link
montage-round-check-error-cannot-load:
Error when the source link cannot be loaded. Parameters:
* {0} - the link
montage-round-check-error-not-public:
Error when the source link points to a private or local address. Parameters:
* {0} - the link
montage-round-check-error-too-large:
Error when the linked file is too large. Parameters:
* {0} - the link
* {1} - the maximum size in megabytes
montage-round-check-error-no-link: Error when no source link was entered.
montage-round-check-error-sheet-not-shar:
Error when a Google Sheet is not shared publicly. The quoted text is the sharing option in Google Sheets; use its name in your language if Google translates it. Parameters:
* {0} - the link
montage-round-check-error-not-utf8:
Error when the linked file has the wrong text encoding. Parameters:
* {0} - the link
montage-round-check-error-no-category: Error when no category was chosen.
montage-round-check-error-no-name-column: Error when a CSV has several columns but none called filename or file_id. filename and file_id are column names and must not be translated.
montage-round-import-saved:
First line of the dialog shown after a round was saved with its files. Parameters:
* {0} - number of files in the round
montage-round-import-left-out: Heading in the dialog after saving, above the rows of the check that were left out or changed (each with its details).
montage-round-import-more:
Last line of a shortened list in the dialog after saving. Parameters:
* {0} - number of rows not shown
montage-round-import-disqualified: Heading in the dialog after saving, above the files disqualified by the round's settings (for example too small).
montage-round-import-all-disqualified: Shown in the dialog after saving when every file was disqualified by the round's settings.
